title: Looking Things Up
description:
New to modded Minecraft? This is the single most useful thing to learn.

The item list down the right side of your inventory is **JEI**. It knows every recipe in the pack.

**Hover an item and press R** — shows you how to make it.
**Hover an item and press U** — shows you what it's used for.

You never need a wiki. If you're wondering how something is made, or what a strange item does, R and U will tell you.

There's a search box at the bottom too.
